about.zh: 红色蓬松短发、金色眼睛和白金色光环的Q版能天使，身穿黑白服装，背后有几何光翼。平时双手放下，可以抬手比耶。
about.en: Chibi Exusiai with scarlet hair, golden eyes, a pale-gold halo and geometric light wings, wearing a black-and-white outfit. Both arms rest down; she can raise a hand for a V sign.
